Raincloud and Half-Boxed Ecology Plot Type

Source: R/type_premier.R
type_raincloud.Rd

Creates publication-ready raincloud and half-boxed distribution plots combining half-violins (density slabs), vertical boxplots, mean markers, and optional statistical summary confidence interval annotations.

Usage

type_raincloud(
  style = c("default", "ecology", "half_boxed"),
  alpha = NULL,
  point_size = 1.5,
  point_alpha = 0.4,
  box_width = NULL,
  box_nudge = NULL,
  box_fill = NULL,
  box_lwd = NULL,
  outlier_shape = NULL,
  outlier_size = NULL,
  outlier_stroke = NULL,
  show_mean = NULL,
  mean_nudge = -0.01,
  mean_shape = 16,
  mean_size = 3.8,
  violin_width = 0.52,
  adjust = 1.1,
  side = "right",
  ref_line = NULL,
  ref_line_col = "grey70",
  ref_line_lty = "dashed",
  ref_line_lwd = 1.2,
  show_stats = NULL,
  stat_param = "λ",
  stat_ci_level = 0.95,
  stat_digits = 3,
  stat_y_pos = NULL,
  stat_text_size = 3.4,
  stat_labels = NULL
)

Arguments

style

Aesthetic style: `"default"` (classic neuroscience raincloud with jittered points) or `"ecology"` / `"half_boxed"` (clean ecology/demography style with white-filled boxplot, category-matched borders, open square outliers, prominent circular mean dot, right-facing half-violin density, horizontal reference line, and bottom-positioned mean + 95 percent CI text annotations).

alpha

Violin transparency (default 0.7 for default, 0.98 for ecology).

point_size

Size of jittered points in default style (default 1.5).

point_alpha

Transparency of jittered points in default style (default 0.4).

box_width

Width of boxplot (default 0.2 for default, 0.17 for ecology).

box_nudge

Horizontal nudge for boxplot in ecology style (default -0.15).

box_fill

Fill color of boxplot (default white `"#FFFFFF"` in ecology style, semi-transparent in default).

box_lwd

Line width for boxplot borders and whiskers (default 1.1 for ecology style).

outlier_shape

Outlier point shape (default `0` [open square] for ecology style, `NA` for default).

outlier_size

Outlier point size (default 2.0 for ecology style).

outlier_stroke

Outlier border stroke thickness (default 0.8 for ecology style).

show_mean

Logical. Draw a solid circular mean marker between boxplot and violin (default TRUE for ecology style).

mean_nudge

Horizontal nudge for mean point (default -0.01).

mean_shape

Mean marker shape (default 16, solid circle).

mean_size

Mean marker size (default 3.8).

violin_width

Width of half-violin slab (default 0.52).

adjust

Bandwidth adjustment for density estimation (default 1.1).

side

Which side to draw the half-violin: `"right"`, `"left"`, or `"both"`.

ref_line

Numeric y-intercept for horizontal dashed reference line (e.g. `1.0` for population replacement rate). `NULL` to disable.

ref_line_col

Color for reference line (default `"grey70"`).

ref_line_lty

Linetype for reference line (default `"dashed"`).

ref_line_lwd

Linewidth for reference line (default 1.2).

show_stats

Logical. Compute and display sample mean and confidence intervals below each category (default TRUE for ecology style).

stat_param

Parameter symbol or name for stats label (default `"λ"`, or `"mean"`).

stat_ci_level

Confidence interval level (default 0.95 for 95 percent CI).

stat_digits

Number of decimal digits to format in stats label (default 3).

stat_y_pos

Custom y-coordinate for bottom stats labels. `NULL` automatically calculates position below minimum data range.

stat_text_size

Font size for bottom stats labels (default 3.4).

stat_labels

Optional custom character vector to override calculated stats labels.

Value

A cliplot_type object.
